data.one_liner: Graph algorithms that operate on graphs in any representation.
data.what_it_does: Provides generic graph algorithms like topological sort, strongly connected components, transitive closure, and shortest paths. Functions accept custom edge-traversal mechanisms so they work with any data structure representing your graph.
use_when: You need to run graph algorithms like topological sort or shortest path on custom data structures
You want to traverse graphs asynchronously or synchronously without locking into a specific graph schema
avoid_when: You need a complete UI charting library or visual graph rendering solution
You are looking for state management or dependency injection tools
strengths: Independent of any specific graph data representation
Supports both synchronous and asynchronous graph resolution
Includes iterative algorithms to avoid stack overflows on very large graphs
weaknesses: Does not include UI widgets or visual graph rendering capabilities
Does not provide a built-in graph data structure class out of the box
